actual_service.declared_behavior: drain process score updates and acknowledge synchronous commands; never kill a process

deployment_prerequisites: Real LMKD selection and foreground-safety canaries must pass before Main activation.
Service executable and exact environment must be changed and verified deliberately; system/bin file hash alone is insufficient.
Pressure monitor access needs a separately reviewed scoped design retaining namespace isolation, resource limits, and LMKD membership in the pressured domain.
Do not disable nsdelegate, broaden visible cgroup scope, move LMKD outside pressure, or relax limits to pass.

kernel_source_check.condition: cgroup_file_write returns EPERM for non-delegatable files at a non-initial cgroup namespace root when nsdelegate is set; memory.pressure has no CFTYPE_NS_DELEGATABLE flag.
kernel_source_check.inference: The observed layout matches the upstream Linux v7.0 denial condition for in-namespace root memory.pressure trigger registration. No Main write was attempted, and this is not a runtime EPERM receipt or a claim about uninspected downstream kernel changes.

scope: Read-only service, selected environment, cgroup files, and a short-lived observer entering only the existing cgroup namespace to read target membership. No Main write or process migration.
